svg.title: LRUCache O(1) HashMap and Doubly Linked List Animation
svg.desc: Animated trace of LRUCache (capacity = 3) showing (1) get(2) hitting HashMap bucket 2, unlinking Node 2 from the middle of the doubly linked list, and moving it to Head (MRU), and (2) put(4, 40) when full evicting Tail.prev (LRU Node 1) and inserting Node 4 at Head (MRU).

g.text: cap = 3 | (1) get(2) -> moveToHead | (2) put(4, 40) -> evict LRU
HASHMAP<INTEGER, NODE> CACHE | O(1) KEY -> NODE LOOKUP
LRU is still Node(1) at tail.prev
Zero scans: both ops strictly O(1)
Step 2: get(2) -> HashMap bucket 2 O(1) lookup hits Node [2:20] in middle
Step 3: removeNode([2:20]) -> Unlink from middle; [3:30] <-> [1:10] snap-link
Step 4: addToHead([2:20]) -> Promoted to HEAD (MRU) & returns 20 in O(1)
Step 5: put(4, 40) at capacity (3/3) -> tail.prev identifies LRU Node [1:10]
Step 6: removeLeast() -> Evict [1:10], link [3:30] <-> TAIL, cache.remove(1)
Step 7: cache.put(4, node) + addToHead([4:40]) -> New MRU at HEAD.next
Step 8: Updated O(1) Cache — HEAD <-> [4:40] <-> [2:20] <-> [3:30] <-> TAIL
